notes: Navigation tidy-up. The sidebar is now organised into a clear repair workflow — Diagnose → Optimise → Repair → Parts & sourcing → Deliver → Workshop — instead of the old scattered groups. Each group heading now collapses and expands (click it), and it remembers what you've collapsed, so the long list isn't in your face; whichever section you're working in opens itself automatically. The old 'Drivers' and 'Devices' tabs — which overlapped (one was the fix tool, one was the read-only problem list) — are now a single 'Drivers & Devices' entry with a little switch at the top to flip between 'Driver fix & library' and 'Problem devices'. Everything still jumps correctly from the Ctrl+K quick-find. No features removed, just easier to get around.
